title: Low Cholesterol Turkey Tacos
description: Ready in under an hour, these low-cholesterol tacos feature a flavorful mix of turkey, chile powder, salsa, green chile, and fresh toppings.
ingredients: 1 cup Mexican salsa (such as Herdez®), drained
1 (4.5 ounce) can diced green chile peppers, drained
1 tablespoon chopped fresh cilantro, or to taste
salt and ground black pepper to taste
1 cup shredded Monterey Jack cheese, or to taste
1 cup shredded lettuce, or to taste

steps.text: Heat a lightly oiled large skillet over medium-high heat. Sauté turkey and onion in the hot skillet until browned, about 8 minutes. Drain and discard juice.

Stir chile powder, garlic powder, and onion powder into turkey-onion mixture until well combined. Mix in salsa, green chile peppers, cilantro, salt, and pepper. Cook, stirring occasionally, until flavors meld, 7 to 10 minutes.
Fill taco shells with seasoned turkey mixture. Top with avocado, cheese, lettuce, and tomatoes.
